obligations.expected_behavior: The detached positive Probe must pass with its bound input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence.
forbidden_result: A positive Probe failure is accepted as successful validation.
A positive Probe lacks its required bindings.
obligations.observable_result: A detached positive-Probe receipt records a passing result and all required bindings.
obligations.state_after: The positive Probe has independently demonstrated passing validation.
obligations.state_before: Positive-Probe passing behavior is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Detached positive-Probe oracle

obligations.expected_behavior: The detached negative Probe must fail for its declared defect and expected diagnostic category.
forbidden_result: Infrastructure failure is accepted as successful negative validation.
A negative Probe passes or fails with an undeclared diagnostic category.
obligations.observable_result: A detached negative-Probe receipt records failure for the declared defect and expected diagnostic category.
obligations.state_after: The negative Probe has independently demonstrated validator discrimination.
obligations.state_before: Negative-Probe declared-defect failure is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Detached negative-Probe oracle

obligations.expected_behavior: Stable eligibility must require verifiable provenance for source-supported existing behavior and an immutable identity bound before the run.
forbidden_result: A temporary package qualifies as Stable merely because it differs from Candidate.
Stable lacks verifiable provenance or a pre-run immutable identity.
obligations.observable_result: Stable eligibility records verifiable source provenance and an immutable identity bound before execution.
obligations.state_after: Only source-qualified immutable Stable subjects are eligible.
obligations.state_before: Stable provenance eligibility is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Stable subject eligibility
obligations.trigger: A Stable Package is selected for a Matrix Case.

obligations.expected_behavior: Candidate must contain the real change under evaluation.
forbidden_result: A Candidate without the evaluated real change is used for comparison.
A comparison subject is labeled Candidate without containing the relevant change.
obligations.observable_result: Candidate identity and content demonstrate inclusion of the real change under evaluation.
obligations.state_after: The Candidate subject is bound to the real evaluated change.
obligations.state_before: Candidate content is not yet required to contain the evaluated real change.
obligations.subject: Candidate subject eligibility
obligations.trigger: A Candidate Package is selected for a Matrix Case.

obligations.expected_behavior: The valid-package Matrix Case must execute both subjects and handle a valid package under its declared contract.
forbidden_result: The valid-package case is omitted or executes fewer than both subjects.
A valid package is not handled under its declared contract.
obligations.observable_result: Separate Stable and Candidate observations record execution of the valid-package case under its declared contract.
obligations.state_after: The valid-package Matrix Case has two-sided execution evidence.
obligations.state_before: The valid-package Matrix Case is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Valid-package Matrix Case

obligations.expected_behavior: The invalid-package Matrix Case must execute both subjects and reject an independently malformed package for its intended defect.
forbidden_result: The invalid-package case is omitted or executes fewer than both subjects.
A package not independently malformed for its intended defect is accepted as the invalid-package case.
obligations.observable_result: Separate Stable and Candidate observations record intended-defect rejection for the independently malformed package.
obligations.state_after: The invalid-package Matrix Case has two-sided intended-defect rejection evidence.
obligations.state_before: The invalid-package Matrix Case is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Invalid-package Matrix Case

obligations.expected_behavior: The historical-compatibility Matrix Case must execute both subjects and state machine-bound historical limits without authority promotion.
forbidden_result: The historical-compatibility case is omitted or executes fewer than both subjects.
Historical compatibility is promoted to current authority.
obligations.observable_result: Separate Stable and Candidate observations state the machine-bound historical limits without authority promotion.
obligations.state_after: The historical-compatibility Matrix Case has two-sided non-authorizing evidence.
obligations.state_before: The historical-compatibility Matrix Case is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Historical-compatibility Matrix Case

obligations.expected_behavior: The dirty-baseline Matrix Case must execute both subjects and detect and prevent Candidate identity contamination.
forbidden_result: The dirty-baseline case is omitted or executes fewer than both subjects.
Candidate identity contamination is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: Separate Stable and Candidate observations demonstrate detection and prevention of Candidate identity contamination.
obligations.state_after: The dirty-baseline Matrix Case has two-sided contamination-prevention evidence.
obligations.state_before: The dirty-baseline Matrix Case is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Dirty-baseline Matrix Case

obligations.expected_behavior: The knowledge read-set collision Matrix Case must execute both subjects and detect the collision without self-reference.
forbidden_result: The knowledge read-set collision case is omitted or executes fewer than both subjects.
Collision detection relies on self-reference.
obligations.observable_result: Separate Stable and Candidate observations demonstrate knowledge read-set collision detection without self-reference.
obligations.state_after: The knowledge read-set collision Matrix Case has two-sided collision evidence.
obligations.state_before: The knowledge read-set collision Matrix Case is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Knowledge read-set collision Matrix Case

obligations.expected_behavior: The closed-policy architecture-index-gap Matrix Case must execute both subjects and fail until the required policy/index relationship is satisfied.
forbidden_result: The closed-policy architecture-index-gap case is omitted or executes fewer than both subjects.
The case succeeds while the required policy/index relationship is unsatisfied.
obligations.observable_result: Separate Stable and Candidate observations show failure until the required policy/index relationship is satisfied.
obligations.state_after: The closed-policy architecture-index-gap Matrix Case has two-sided fail-closed evidence.
obligations.state_before: The closed-policy architecture-index-gap Matrix Case is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Closed-policy architecture-index-gap Matrix Case

obligations.expected_behavior: Each Matrix Case must own a frozen expectation and separate observations.
forbidden_result: Matrix Cases share observations.
A Matrix Case executes without its own frozen expectation.
obligations.observable_result: Each Matrix Case records its own frozen expectation and separate observations.
obligations.state_after: All Matrix Cases have case-owned expectations and observations.
obligations.state_before: Case-owned expectations and separate observations are not yet required.
obligations.subject: Matrix expectation and observation ownership
obligations.trigger: A Matrix Case is prepared or evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: An expected-difference is valid only when frozen for that Matrix Case and all execution and evidence gates pass, and it cannot approve a regression.
forbidden_result: An unfrozen expected-difference is accepted.
Expected-difference approves a regression.
Expected-difference bypasses execution or evidence gates.
obligations.observable_result: Any accepted expected-difference is case-frozen, passes all execution and evidence gates, and does not approve a regression.
obligations.state_after: Expected-difference is constrained to valid non-regression use.
obligations.state_before: Expected-difference validity restrictions are not yet required.
obligations.subject: Expected-difference validity

obligations.expected_behavior: The Consumer Manifest must be non-empty and frozen before review.
forbidden_result: An empty Consumer Manifest is accepted.
The Consumer Manifest changes after review begins.
obligations.observable_result: A non-empty version-bound Consumer Manifest is recorded before review.
obligations.state_after: A non-empty Consumer Manifest is frozen before review.
obligations.state_before: Consumer Manifest non-emptiness and review-time freezing are not yet required.
obligations.subject: Consumer Manifest lifecycle

obligations.expected_behavior: Each Consumer must bind its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
forbidden_result: A Consumer receipt omits any required actual invocation binding.
A declared rather than actual interface, input, command, output, result, or dependency is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: Each Consumer receipt contains its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependency bindings.
obligations.state_after: All Consumer invocations are fully bound to their actual execution details.
obligations.state_before: Per-Consumer actual invocation binding is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Consumer invocation binding

obligations.expected_behavior: For every applicable Consumer, enable must invoke the Candidate Route and observe Candidate behavior and evidence.
forbidden_result: Enable omits the Candidate Route invocation.
Candidate behavior or evidence is not observed for an applicable Consumer.
obligations.observable_result: Each applicable Consumer has an enable receipt showing a Candidate Route invocation and observed Candidate behavior and evidence.
obligations.state_after: Enable has executed through the Candidate Route for every applicable Consumer.
obligations.state_before: Enable route semantics are not yet required for every applicable Consumer.
obligations.subject: Enable transition route semantics

obligations.expected_behavior: For every applicable Consumer, disable must invoke the Prior Route and reproduce Prior Route identity and the Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
forbidden_result: Disable does not invoke the Prior Route.
Prior Route identity or the Prior Behavior Baseline is not reproduced for every applicable fixture.
obligations.observable_result: Each applicable Consumer has a disable receipt showing Prior Route invocation and per-fixture reproduction of Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.
obligations.state_after: Disable has reproduced the Prior Behavior Baseline through the Prior Route.
obligations.state_before: Disable route semantics and per-fixture baseline reproduction are not yet required.
obligations.subject: Disable transition route semantics

obligations.expected_behavior: For every applicable rollback fixture, rollback must invoke the Prior Route rather than merely changing state; rejection, error, and configuration-only changes do not qualify.
forbidden_result: Rollback is represented only by a state setter, rejection, error, or configuration change.
Rollback does not invoke the Prior Route.
obligations.observable_result: Rollback receipts show Prior Route invocation for every applicable rollback fixture and exclude nonqualifying substitutes.
obligations.state_after: Rollback is demonstrated by actual Prior Route execution.
obligations.state_before: Rollback route invocation and substitute rejection are not yet required.
obligations.subject: Rollback transition route semantics
obligations.trigger: Rollback is exercised for an applicable fixture.

obligations.expected_behavior: Any Consumer-transition applicability exception must be approved and bound before execution, and implementations cannot skip a transition themselves.
forbidden_result: An applicability exception is unapproved, unbound, or approved after execution.
An implementation creates its own transition omission.
obligations.observable_result: Each omitted transition has a pre-execution approved and bound applicability exception; no unapproved implementation-created omission is accepted.
obligations.state_after: Transition omissions are limited to pre-approved, bound applicability exceptions.
obligations.state_before: Applicability-exception authorization and binding are not yet required.
obligations.subject: Consumer-transition applicability exceptions
obligations.trigger: A Consumer transition would be omitted.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each behavioral Exact-Cover obligation must have its own observable independent fault witness.
forbidden_result: A behavioral obligation lacks an observable fault witness.
A fault witness is reused without independently observing the behavioral obligation.
obligations.observable_result: Every behavioral Atomic Obligation maps to its own independently observable fault witness.
obligations.state_after: Behavioral Exact-Cover obligations have independent fault witnesses.
obligations.state_before: Behavioral witness type and independence are not yet required.
obligations.subject: Behavioral Exact-Cover witness semantics
obligations.trigger: Exact Cover is constructed or validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each nonbehavioral Exact-Cover obligation must have a deterministic violation witness.
forbidden_result: A nonbehavioral obligation lacks a deterministic violation witness.
A nondeterministic witness is accepted for a nonbehavioral obligation.
obligations.observable_result: Every nonbehavioral Atomic Obligation maps to a deterministic violation witness.
obligations.state_after: Nonbehavioral Exact-Cover obligations have deterministic violation witnesses.
obligations.state_before: Nonbehavioral deterministic witness requirements are not yet established.
obligations.subject: Nonbehavioral Exact-Cover witness semantics
obligations.trigger: Exact Cover is constructed or validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Before implementation, Exact Cover must decompose every FR consequence, NFR, guardrail, and retained historical sub-duty into independently decidable Atomic Obligations.
forbidden_result: Implementation begins without decomposition of every listed source category.
An Atomic Obligation is not independently decidable.
obligations.observable_result: The Atomic-Obligation universe contains independently decidable coverage for every FR consequence, NFR, guardrail, and retained historical sub-duty before implementation.
obligations.state_after: Exact Cover is founded on the complete required source universe before implementation.
obligations.state_before: The complete Atomic-Obligation source universe has not yet been required before implementation.
obligations.subject: Exact-Cover source universe

obligations.expected_behavior: A current equivalent replay must create new process evidence and state its equivalence boundary, while the original machine-bound command remains only a native historical fact.
forbidden_result: Historical command evidence is treated as current execution authority or portability proof.
An equivalent replay lacks new process evidence or an equivalence boundary.
obligations.observable_result: New process evidence for the equivalent replay states its equivalence boundary and preserves the original command solely as historical fact.
obligations.state_after: Historical-command compatibility is observed through a bounded current equivalent replay without authority promotion.
obligations.state_before: Only the machine-bound historical command exists as historical context.
obligations.subject: Historical-command equivalence replay

obligations.expected_behavior: Budget exhaustion must never reduce coverage.
forbidden_result: Budget exhaustion reduces required coverage.
Reduced coverage is accepted because execution budget was exhausted.
obligations.observable_result: An exhausted run retains its complete required coverage set rather than removing obligations, cases, Consumers, or transitions.
obligations.state_after: Budget exhaustion leaves required coverage unchanged.
obligations.state_before: Coverage preservation under budget exhaustion is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Bounded-execution coverage preservation
obligations.trigger: An external-process or aggregate-run budget is exhausted.

obligations.expected_behavior: Only the current Acceptance lifecycle owner may publish acceptance-passed, and only after required independent review and scoped approval.
forbidden_result: A foreign or historical lifecycle owner publishes acceptance-passed.
Acceptance-passed is published before required independent review or scoped approval.
obligations.observable_result: An acceptance-passed publication identifies the current Acceptance lifecycle owner and bound prior independent-review and scoped-approval prerequisites.
obligations.state_after: Acceptance-passed publication is restricted to the current owner after all required prerequisites.
obligations.state_before: Acceptance-passed publication prerequisites are not yet completely required.
obligations.subject: Acceptance-passed publication prerequisites

obligations.expected_behavior: Writes to installed _bmad/**, .agents/skills/bmad-*/**, and .agents/skills/gds-*/** paths must be rejected.
forbidden_result: A TC-D1 repair writes to an installed protected Skill path.
Permission to repair replay or Consumer code authorizes an installed protected Skill write.
obligations.observable_result: A write targeting any listed installed Skill path is rejected.
obligations.state_after: Installed Skill paths remain protected from TC-D1 writes.
obligations.state_before: The installed-Skill write boundary is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Installed Skill write boundary
obligations.trigger: A TC-D1 repair attempts a write to an installed Skill path.

obligations.expected_behavior: Writes to Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and sandbox paths must be rejected by the TC-D1 repair boundary.
forbidden_result: A TC-D1 repair writes to a Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, or sandbox path.
TC-D1 repair authority is treated as authority to modify protected system or user-sandbox paths.
obligations.observable_result: A write targeting any listed Phase or user-sandbox boundary path is rejected.
obligations.state_after: Phase and user-sandbox paths remain outside the TC-D1 repair write boundary.
obligations.state_before: The Phase and sandbox write boundary is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Phase and sandbox write boundary
obligations.trigger: A TC-D1 repair attempts a write to a protected Phase or user-sandbox path.

obligations.expected_behavior: Production behavior changes require a prior real defect-revealing test; fabricated RED or post-hoc failure evidence is invalid.
forbidden_result: A production behavior change proceeds without a prior real defect-revealing test.
Fabricated RED or post-hoc failure evidence is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: A production behavior change has temporally prior real defect-revealing test evidence, with no fabricated or post-hoc failure evidence accepted.
obligations.state_after: Production behavior changes are preceded by valid defect-revealing test evidence.
obligations.state_before: The required prior defect-revealing test condition is not yet established.
obligations.subject: Defect-revealing test prerequisite
obligations.trigger: A production behavior change is proposed.

obligations.expected_behavior: TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation must be rejected as outside TC-D1 scope.
forbidden_result: TC-E0 or TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation is accepted as TC-D1 work.
obligations.observable_result: A request to implement TC-E0 or TC-D2 through TC-D6 is rejected as outside TC-D1 scope.
obligations.state_after: TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 remain excluded from TC-D1 implementation.
obligations.state_before: The TC-D1 roadmap-scope boundary is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Roadmap-scope boundary
obligations.trigger: TC-E0 or TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation is requested within TC-D1.

obligations.expected_behavior: Seeds, packages, and Skill versions must not be promoted or admitted as evaluation-set members within TC-D1.
forbidden_result: A seed, package, or Skill version is promoted within TC-D1.
A seed, package, or Skill version is admitted as an evaluation-set member within TC-D1.
obligations.observable_result: Promotion or evaluation-set admission of a seed, package, or Skill version within TC-D1 is rejected.
obligations.state_after: Seeds, packages, and Skill versions remain non-promoted and outside evaluation-set membership within TC-D1.
obligations.state_before: The TC-D1 promotion and evaluation-set boundary is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Promotion and evaluation-set boundary
obligations.trigger: Promotion or evaluation-set admission is requested within TC-D1.

obligations.expected_behavior: TC-D1 must exclude Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, SkillOS, learned ranking, percentage canaries, reinforcement learning, generalized governance, review-topology experiments, and cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence.
forbidden_result: Any listed excluded feature is accepted as TC-D1 scope.
Cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence is introduced as TC-D1 work.
obligations.observable_result: A request to add any listed excluded feature is rejected as outside TC-D1 scope.
obligations.state_after: All explicitly excluded features remain outside TC-D1 scope.
obligations.state_before: The excluded-feature scope boundary is not yet required.
obligations.subject: Excluded feature scope
obligations.trigger: An excluded feature is proposed as TC-D1 work.
